name: @projexlight/sdk-feature-flags
summary: Per-tenant feature flags + progressive rollouts for ProjexCloud: define a flag, target by tenant / persona / cohort, ramp from 1% to 100% with a kill-switch and an evaluation log. Audit-grade — every flag check leaves a trail so a regulator can replay 'which code path served this customer at time T'.

endpoints.description: Create or update a flag definition.
Fetch flag + current rollout + recent evaluations.
Evaluate a flag for a specific (persona, tenant, cohort) tuple.

events.name: feature_flags.rollout.advanced.v1
events.description: Rollout step advanced; carries old + new percentage + persona who advanced.

events.name: feature_flags.kill_switch.fired.v1
events.description: Kill-switch toggled. Critical for incident audit chain.

events.name: feature_flags.evaluation.sampled.v1
events.description: Sample of evaluations stored for replay (rate-limited to keep volume manageable).

models.description: Per-flag row: name, default_value, kind (bool/string/number), kill_switch_pulled.
Per-rollout row: flag_id, percentage, targeting_rules_json, advanced_at.
Per-sample row: flag_id, persona_id, evaluated_value, reason.

hooks.name: evaluate
hooks.description: Evaluate a flag for a (persona, tenant) tuple. SDK-side cache keeps this O(1).

hooks.name: killSwitch
hooks.description: Set kill-switch on; all evaluations return default until reverted.

hooks.name: startTargetingCache
hooks.description: Background worker: hot-loads targeting rules to keep evaluate() in-memory.

scenarios.title: Create a new flag for a beta feature
scenarios.when_to_use: Eng wants to ship a new dashboard behind a flag; default off, beta-cohort on.

scenarios.title: Application code calls evaluate() to gate UI rendering
scenarios.when_to_use: Universal pattern — feature-flag check on every server-rendered page or request.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns value + reason. SDK cache makes this O(1) microseconds. Sampled into .evaluation.sampled.v1 per FF_EVALUATION_SAMPLE_RATE.

scenarios.title: Ramp rollout 10% → 50%
scenarios.when_to_use: Beta went well; ops ramps to 50% of all tenants.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Rollout advanced; emits .rollout.advanced.v1. New evaluations route 50% of users into the new path.

scenarios.title: Incident — pull the kill-switch instantly
scenarios.when_to_use: New dashboard crashes for 10% of users mid-rollout; pull kill-switch + investigate.
scenarios.expected_outcome: All future evaluations return default (false). Emits .kill_switch.fired.v1 — critical for the post-incident audit chain. Cache invalidates within sec.

scenarios.title: Reactive: drop tenant-scoped flags on offboard
scenarios.when_to_use: tenant.offboarded.v1 fires; drop the tenant's flag rows so they don't accumulate.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Flag rows + rollouts deleted. Cache invalidates.

compliance_posture.notes: Sampled evaluation log lets a regulator replay which code path served any customer at any time — critical for EU AI Act algorithm-transparency + SOX change-mgmt. Kill-switch event is the canonical incident-response artifact.
